notes.title: Subject: Commemoration of Yuppie Psycho’s 5th Anniversary
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32192720/c98aaf2803c492d33f12320aeb0e45a53fa6fd0c.jpg[/img]

To All Personnel:
[b] [Party-Party-Party-ti-tiki-tiki-tiki][/b]

As we commemorate the 5th anniversary of Yuppie Psycho, we reflect on the remarkable journey since its inception. The game’s debut, Brian’s first job, was met with an unexpected and heartwarming reception that continues to resonate with us. The creativity and engagement of our community, evident in fanart and live streams, are a source of joy and pride.

[list]
[*][b]Polish Localization by Studio Kiełkun:[/b]
The game’s text has been fully localized to Polish, courtesy of Studio Kiełkun! This update will be applied automatically. For the full Polish experience including cutscenes and songs, follow this [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3224124192][b]link [/b][/url] for detailed installation instructions.

[*][b]Yuppie Psycho x Crunchyroll:[/b]
Take your corporate horror adventure on the go! Yuppie Psycho is now available on mobile exclusively for Crunchyroll Game Vault members.

[*][b]New Icons and Stickers for Our Discord Server:[/b]
Our Discord server just got a massive upgrade with over 100 new icons and stickers! Express yourself and connect with the community [url=https://t.co/0T9CSryevZ][b]here[/b][/url]

[*][b]Special Anniversary Animation:[/b]
Don’t miss the exclusive animation created by the talented @vijzon, featured in our latest Devlog for our upcoming game Catechesis.
[/list]

[previewyoutube=deDooObQF08;full][/previewyoutube]

We’re immensely grateful for the journey we’ve shared over the past five years. But hold onto your sanity, because there’s more to come!

“Catechesis”, our brand-new game, is on the horizon. Dive into a world of mystery, intrigue, and soul-saving quests. Add it to your wishlist now to ensure your salvation!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2593320/Catechesis/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32192720/e2e2360f20719477c40bd3630814a64a1e6ebf24.jpg[/img]

Credits:
Voiceover by Maddi Albregts
Music by Michael "Garoad" Kelly
Yuppie Psycho Anniversary Animation @vijzon
Polish Localization by Studio Kiełkun

notes.title: Soundtrack Update for The Count Lucanor
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11867685/ac56261ef48f9c721dc69006c6b2f10133df9b85.jpg[/img]

We’re excited to share that the The Count Lucanor Soundtrack, which was previously added as a complimentary bonus with the game, has received an important fix! 🛠️

Due to an outdated system on Steam, some players experienced issues accessing the soundtrack. We’ve now implemented a fix to ensure smooth and proper functionality. 🎉

You can now enjoy the haunting chiptune melodies of The Count Lucanor directly from your Steam library’s Soundtrack tab.

Thank you for your patience, and happy listening!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11867685/5dcf09d4ba9cfae76879660fda4157cb082b2cd8.gif[/img]

tags.bug: We’ve now implemented a fix to ensure smooth and proper functionality.

notes.title: Physical Edition for PS4 & Switch!
notes.content:
[h2]Join Brian Pasternack this Summer for the very first time in physical format! [/h2]
Born from the collaboration between the indie studio Baroque Decay and the publishers Neon Doctrine , Tesura Games and VGNY. Yuppie Psycho physical edition will be real for Nintendo Switch and PlayStation 4 in four completely different editions full of [b]exclusive content[/b]:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11867685/acf3fd12f5801c0f41a89027be650093ef19226e.jpg[/img]

[h2][u][b]EU Editions (Switch & PS4):[/b][/u][/h2]

[b]Executive Edition content:[/b]
[list]
[*] EU standard Edition, Case and Physical Cartridge
[*] The Yuppie Handbook, featuring 30 pages of exclusive content.
[*] Stickers Sheet.
[*] Digital OST.
[/list]
[b]Collectors Edition content:[/b]
[list]
[*] Yuppie Psycho Executive Edition (Handbook, Stickers, Digital OST).
[*] Collector's Box.
[*] Complete 2CDs OST.
[*] Mr. Devil Pin.
[*] Acrylic Diorama.
[*] Super Toad Mask.
[*] Employee of the Month Card “with a secret”.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11867685/02a440eaf8031b566c08df82181d6f5eaf7222ab.jpg[/img]

[h2][u][b]USA Editions (Switch):[/b][/u][/h2]

[b]Standard Edition:[/b]
[list]
[*] USA standard Edition, Case and Physical Cartridge
[*] Certificate of Authenticity
[/list]
[b]Elite Edition:[/b]
[list]
[*] 24 Page Booklet
[*] Brian Pasternack Employee ID Card
[*] Sintracorp Safety Information FOLDED Poster
[*] Premium Metallic Effect Cover
[*] Individually Numbered
[*] Physical Cartridge
[*] Certificate of Authenticity
[/list]

[h2]All the editions can be purchased internationally. And can be preordered right now!

[b]EU Editions: [/b]
[url=https://en.tesuragames.com/games/yuppie-psycho-executive-edition/][u][b]Check available online stores on this website[/b][/u][/url]

[b]USA Editions:[/b]
[url=https://www.vgnysoft.com/product-page/yuppie-psycho-executive-edition-elite-edition-nintendo-switch][u][b]Preorder here[/b][/u][/url][/h2]

notes.title: First Anniversary Update: Chinese & Turkish Languages Added
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/8LmSWkF.jpg[/img]

Welcome again to our humble Tenebre Castle, dear friend. This week is a special one and thus we are in luscious celebration. It's been a long year since our castle first opened its gates, and this week we have returned with a number of unexpected and astonishing surprises:

Our distinguished Count Lucanor decided to lower our castle taxes by 50%.

Two foreign travelers from faraway lands decided to translate Hans’ adventures to their own languages: Chinese and Turkish!
[list]
    [*]Simplified Chinese by Sound of Mystery (http://www.bilibili.com/video/av5304327/)
    [*]Turkish by Gökdeniz Özkan - GogoXe
(facebook&instagram.com/zkngkdnz)
[/list]

And for this special week we have to share this astounding art by [url=https://imagecomics.com/creators/view/emma-rios] Emma Rios [/url] ( @emmartian ) 
Emma is known for her work on Marvel (DOCTOR STRANGE, AMAZING SPIDERMAN) and her work ISLAND and PRETTY DEADLY.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/J0KJYx7.jpg[/img]

We have more surprises coming later in the week, so stay tuned here and at our Twitter account @baroquedecay!

notes.title: Sales, New Languages, Linux & Mac
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/cE0dJ8J.gif[/img]

Hello my amigos of the Tenebre Castle. Today we have some great news to share with you.
This whole week, there's a 25% discount because the black death just killed a rival kingdom and we just have to celebrate it. Bravo!

We also received the visit of two travelers to our castle, two foreigners from Russia and Hungary. They helped us to translate our story to their mother language.
Thanks a lot, for the great job to:
[list]
    [*]Tolma4 Team (Russian)
    [*]Richárd Goz (Magyar)
[/list]
We have more travelers from around the world interested in the hidden treasure of the Count Lucanor, they are working on several translations that will be available soon: German, Portuguese, Polish, Vietnamese & Japanese.
Last word about translations : we would like to ask for your help on the english translation. Several people noted some unusual words and sentences in the game texts. English is not our native language so we're requesting help from native english speaker to make our game even better. If you're willing to give us a hand, ( for free ), please contact us (n_n)

Last but not least, the Linux and Mac builds will be available during this week, so stay tuned dear travelers!
